title: Structure and Definitions
english: They have an ordered number here, as many as the written origin has by this monosyllable ω6ρ6; and they are especially in Job. But as for those concerning the disagreement of certain sayings which have commentaries in the text or in the editions, which are also marked below as having been arranged, those which the opponents of the book are. But as for those sayings lying outside doubtfully, they have marked arrangements outside, which were added through the commentaries according to the great teacher, so that the commentary might not seem to be brought in vain; for in many copies of the sayings this is present, but in this one it is not placed at all, and for this reason they were added.

Proverb 77 is a word signifying intelligible things through sensible things. B The Kingdom of Israel is spiritual knowledge containing discourses  concerning God and incorporeal and corporeal things and judgment and providence, or revealing the theory concerning ethics, physics, and theology. For this reason he says: He caused instruction and wisdom to reign in Israel (1 Kings 4:30). And wisdom indeed is the knowledge of corporeal and incorporeal things and of the judgment and providence observed in these; but instruction is the moderation of passions, observing the passionate or irrational part of the soul. d To direct the judgment shows that the criterion is just and uncorrupted. But there are three criteria in us: sensation, word, and mind; sensation indeed of sensible things; word of names and sayings and things spoken; but mind of intelligible things. A Just as through sensations the mind imposes itself upon the  sensible, so also through virtues it surveys the intelligible; therefore the wise Solomon teaches us that these possess the character of sensation. B Those who suppress evil will despise wisdom and instruction;  1 but in word, I think, no one despises wisdom and instruction. c Just as just as the summit and the neck show the mind, so also the crown and the collar show it.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
